title: Decomposition amendment (phase 1c + 1a/1b): re-sequence the build to front-load the enforcement spine — invariant-first applied to build order — resolving the enforcement-gap class (#806 routing, #809 amendment-discipline, and the Layer-8 directive-classification they share)

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content:
DIRECTIVE CLASSIFICATION of operator 'B' (2026-07-27): SPEC AMENDMENT — a re-decomposition. It amends the contract's Decomposition section (phase 1c) driven by the invariant-first principle (phase 1a/1b). Amend-then-act: the contract changes only through the design process, NOT a solo edit — doing it by hand would repeat the #808 deviation we are mid-remediating.

VEHICLE: the estate's design affordance (the design workflow / skill), attended — 'design authoring the chassis design workflow' per the act-to-affordance map; hand-rolling an equivalent is the nonconformance this whole thread is about. Design is attended (operator present), so this runs collaboratively, then cold-reviewed under composition, then operator-ratified as the exit.

COMPOSITION (proposed; note it differs from the #806/#807 amendment-review composition because a re-decomposition is architecture-led): Solution Architect PRIMARY (decomposition, dependency analysis, the new ordering), Solution Owner (contract-change authority, scope), Documentation Reviewer + Technical Writer (prose, register, Revision line).

SCOPE: (1) adopt invariant-first as a decomposition principle; (2) re-sequence so the enforcement spine — directive classification, the unrouted-findings + round-parity queries, the amendment-discipline gating — is built as early as true dependencies allow (or bootstrap-carried), minimizing the un-self-enforced base; (3) fold in the reverted #806 clauses (routing format-carry + invariant-first) as they find their proper home in the new order. PARKED, rides separately: #807 terminal-safety (a Status-requirement amendment, not decomposition) and the Layer-3 rebuild — both wait until this lands. Entering the design workflow now to author the amendment attended.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: Design draft written: .design/re-sequence-enforcement-spine.md (stored as knowledge, tagged design-doc). 6 requirements, 7 acceptance criteria, 2 open questions (Q1: reopen Layer-2 milestone vs. amendment increment; Q2: the amendment-discipline format-carry's exact shape/home). It authors, on the recommended lines: invariant-first principle; the unrouted-findings query assigned to Layer 2 beside its four built siblings; three bootstrap format-carries (parity existing + routing + amendment-discipline); the mechanized blocking tier kept at its true-dependency layer, cross-referenced; forward-only. Pipeline-state step skipped with reason: this is a spec-amendment track (cold review + ratification), not a kickoff feature build. Next: cold review under the SA-primary / SO / DR-TW composition; the two open questions are review inputs; operator ratifies as the exit.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: REVIEW-ROUND MANIFEST (declared before spend). vehicle: Workflow, attended side (operator present). subject: the draft .design/re-sequence-enforcement-spine.md. composition: solution-architect PRIMARY, solution-owner, documentation-reviewer, technical-writer (operator-confirmed). MODEL chosen: claude-fable-5 all four. EFFORT: SA + SO HIGH, DR + TW MEDIUM. output: per-lens findings on the draft (wrong / missing / mis-scoped / unclear / mis-registered), each lens's verdict (ratify-as-drafted vs revise-then-ratify), and each lens's position on the two open questions. band: 0-14 findings pre-dedup, 120k-280k tokens. After: triage, revise the draft, operator ratifies as the exit; only then does the contract change.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content:
COLD REVIEW RETURNED — 4/4 lenses, unanimous REVISE-THEN-RATIFY (telemetry: 262,362 tokens, chosen=observed fable, SA/SO high + DR/TW medium; in band). All findings ACCEPTED into the revision. Convergent set:
- BLOCKING (SA+SO, DR concurs): the draft moves the unrouted-findings query to Layer 2 but never amends the Status requirement's integrity-query ENUMERATION (the surface Layer 2 reports through) nor the Gates requirement body line — so the query would have no criterion home and the snapshot-schema audit would not cover it. FIX: add both as edited regions; the query joins the Status enumeration, giving it the Status-detection Layer-2 slice as its criterion home.
- BLOCKING (SO): the routing carry as worded flags lawful disposition-closures (dismissed/hallucinated/consolidated) as malformed. FIX: scope the obligation to findings closing BY FIX or surviving open; disposition closures satisfy by their recorded disposition.
- MAJOR: round-parity is double-homed too (Layer 6 lists BOTH siblings). FIX: rewrite the Layer 6 entry for both — Layer 6 delivers the gate COMMANDS consuming Layer 2's unrouted-findings and round-parity queries.
- MAJOR (SA+SO): the Layer-2 increment footprint is understated — it needs a routing field on the snapshot (deny_unknown_fields today), an acquisition extension, the snapshot-schema audit-mirror re-pin, and a convergence-corpus kind-set extension, with its own fresh red-gate seed under the fix-scale gate (NOT the historical Layer 2 gate). FIX: name all four surfaces.
- MAJOR (SO): forward-only never states the query's universe boundary for the pre-amendment closed-unrouted set. FIX: findings closed before the ratification boundary are outside the query's universe; the six-round deviation stands (recorded on #808/#806).
- MAJOR (SO): no fixture/verification reach for the moved query. FIX: add the both-directions detection fixture pair to the corpus enumeration under the named criterion slice.
- REGISTER (TW+DR): 'routing disposition' collides with the sanctioned 'disposition' (a closure kind) -> use 'filed routing / routing record'; 'status integrity set' -> 'process-integrity queries'; define 'format-carry' at first use; 'invariant-first' enters as a registered draft term; 'enforcement spine' stays a draft-side descriptor, not contract text; expand 'UCD' to Unicode character database property.
- WRONG (all): snapshot_integrity computes FIVE kinds not four (omitted phase-pointer-against-milestone-state, the state-integrity member).
- CLARITY (DR): ground the reverted-#806/#807 reference (what/when/#808 handle); fix the region count; make AC-6/AC-7 checkable and match the chronicle shape.

Q1 — UNANIMOUS: tracked Layer-2 amendment increment, do NOT reopen milestone #5 (reopening would make every boundary revocable and destroy sign-off semantics); recorded as a Revision-line amendment at a named boundary; the increment carries its own fresh red-gate seed under the fix-scale gate.
Q2 — CONVERGENT: the amendment-discipline carry lives in the Gates bootstrap paragraph (one home for all carries), keyed to the commit's structured evidence section citing the ratified spec-amendment review's decision record (the existing contracted vehicle), mirroring the parity carry's grammatical formula; mechanized home Layer 7 (blocking — it owns the commit evidence-section linkage, the governed-file read-gate, and the conformance families behind hooks) with Layer 8 directive classification as the complementary detection side.
Revising the draft now on exactly these dispositions; then a terminal verify round, then operator ratification as the exit.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content:
ROUTING OF THE COLD-REVIEW FINDINGS (correcting the batch-collapse — operator-flagged). Split by destination, at the confirmed lighter bootstrap grain:
- FORWARD WORK, filed as tracked routed issues so it cannot orphan: #811 (the Layer-2 built increment — the query's real footprint + its own red-gate seed, routed 2a->2b, blocked on this amendment ratifying) and #812 ('invariant-first' registration as a draft term, operator act at ratification).
- MECHANIZED BLOCKING TIER: tracked-by-decomposition — the Layer 6 phase-4 gate, the Layer 7 contract-commit gate, and the Layer 8 directive-classification detection surface at their owning layers' phase-2a; the amendment names them so they are not lost (no new issue needed).
- DRAFT-REVISION FINDINGS (the register, clarity, count, exemption, double-home, enumeration-as-text items): dispositioned as fixed in the revised draft (.design/re-sequence-enforcement-spine.md), this round's revision. Per-finding child-issue tracking (the loop's full letter, for queryable per-lens yield) is deferred to the enforcement spine that will mechanize it — the lighter grain is the bootstrap stopgap, recorded as such.
Draft revised to resolve every finding; both open questions resolved in-doc. Next: terminal verify round over the revised draft, then operator ratification as the exit.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: TERMINAL VERIFY ROUND — manifest (declared before spend). vehicle: Workflow, attended. subject: the REVISED .design/re-sequence-enforcement-spine.md. composition: SA-primary/SO/DR-TW (same as the review). Each lens verifies its round-1 findings are resolved in the revision AND sweeps for anything the revision introduced, then gives a stop verdict (ratify-ready vs another-cycle) — the loop's closing stage that decides the stop signal. MODEL: fable all four. EFFORT: SA+SO high, DR+TW medium. band: 0-8 findings, 100k-240k tokens. On a clean stop: operator ratifies as the exit.

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: TERMINAL VERIFY ROUND 1 — split 1 ratify-ready (SA) / 2 another-cycle (SO, DR), plus the TW register lens died on a transient classifier error (a dead register lens is not a clean verdict). One real CONVERGENT finding (SO major, DR major, SA minor): the Architecture edit-map undercounted — it listed five regions but REQ-3's format-carry edits and REQ-7's fixture-corpus edit were absent, so an applier would miss two contract edits. Plus two nits: REQ-1/AC-1 form-count (two vs three), and REQ-5 'at or after ratification' misreadable as creation-time not closure-time. All fixed in the draft: edit-map now enumerates seven regions matching every requirement; REQ-1/AC-1 aligned on three forms (detection / format-carry / mechanized gate); REQ-5 reworded to exclude only pre-ratification CLOSURES (open findings stay in the universe). Every substantive round-1 finding was verified RESOLVED by all three returning lenses (Status enumeration, disposition-closure exemption, round-parity double-home, footprint, forward-only, fixture, five-kinds, register, Q1/Q2). Dispatching a final verify: confirm the three fixes + recover the TW register verdict + decide the stop; nits do not block (batch-touch at ratification).

comments.author: xqjG
comments.content: FINAL VERIFY ROUND — UNANIMOUS RATIFY-READY (4/4: SA, SO, DR, TW; the TW register lens recovered on this run). All three fixes confirmed grounded against contract and code: the seven-region edit-map is complete with bijective requirement coverage (no phantom, no missing edit); REQ-1/AC-1 agree on the three forms; REQ-5 keys on closure time. Remaining items are all minor/nit and were APPLIED as batch touches (not deferred): AC-5 anchored to region 4; REQ-5 reopened-finding case spelled out; the footprint names the closure-time datum; REQ-1's all-caps emphasis normalized to the contract register. mdatron clean, no placeholders. The amendment has cleared its full owned process — draft (design affordance) -> composed cold review (revise-then-ratify, blocking finding caught) -> revise -> terminal verify (edit-map defect caught) -> revise -> final verify (ratify-ready). READY FOR OPERATOR RATIFICATION as the phase exit; only on ratification does the contract change.
